description: Use when you want a 13F filer's profile, latest metrics and concentration, and optionally its largest holdings. Not for finding the bw_filer_id (use riskmodels_search) or comparing the book with a benchmark (use riskmodels_get_benchmark_fit). Returns { snapshot, holdings }: snapshot from GET /13f/filers/{bw_filer_id}/snapshot (registry details, latest metrics, concentration); holdings, only when holdings_top is set, from GET /13f/filers/{bw_filer_id}/holdings with the source filing's accession_number, filing_type (13F-HR, 13F-HR/A, 13F-NT) and amendment_type (ORIGINAL, RESTATEMENT, NEW_HOLDINGS or UNKNOWN; null on panels published before filing vintages were stored). Holdings follow the latest 13F filing; metrics use end-of-day prices. Price: $0.05, plus $0.02 when holdings are requested.

bw_filer_id.description: bw_filer_id, e.g. BW-FILER-CIK0001067983, or a composite entity id BW-SYNTH-…

holdings_top.description: Also return the largest N holdings, integer 1-200, e.g. 25 (default: no holdings)

name: riskmodels_get_filer
title: RiskModels 13F Filer
